purpose: Fresh 108-query train discovery probe for information-complete speech-native AgentLoop action support. The frozen decoder jointly matches each original speech feature query against maintainable action-complete text keys. A later contact receives enum-bound speech-conditioned factor ids and one registered train-derived pair boundary only when candidate disagreement identifies a missing-information gap. The online decision remains the speech-only primary; counterfactual actions are logged for later training-free system control without parameter updates, transcript queries, or generated-text-only retrieval.
